note: `datapumpv34`: three loops and four independent `if`s.  Almost every claim here is a constant or a comparison -- the function does no arithmetic beyond three thresholds and one halving -- so the set is mostly boundaries, signedness and widths.  What it has to prove is that the +0x2218 guard is driven both ways, that each of the four supervisor blocks is reached separately, that each block's ORDER of clears is what stops the next one firing, and that the two loops run rather than being skipped.
